name: interkom-mobile
description: Interkom – aplikacja na iPhone i Android (Capacitor + natywny dźwięk LiveKit)

scripts.ios: npx cap sync ios && bash scripts/ios-setup.sh && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npx cap sync android && bash scripts/android-setup.sh && npx cap open android
scripts.sync: npx cap sync && (bash scripts/ios-setup.sh || true) && (bash scripts/android-setup.sh || true)
